_comment: Occultism's spellbooks (docs/systems.md 'Spellbooks', docs/skills.md 3.5): one per house; the active spell is the occult auto-attack and burns its reagents each cast. Provisional names and numbers. Only the Sallow Primer is written so far.

spellbooks.name: The Sallow Primer
spellbooks.description: Corvin Sallow's first lessons: humble workings on crude salt, taught to anyone who asks nicely and pays attention.

spells.name: Bile Lash
spells.description: A flick of humour at whatever you face. Costs nothing but nerve.

spells.name: Salt Sting
spells.description: Crude salt, flung hot. Burns 1 crude salt a cast.

spells.name: Gall Bolt
spells.description: A knot of gall that bursts on contact. Burns 2 crude salt a cast.

spells.name: Brine Lance
spells.description: Brine drawn tight and driven through. Burns 3 crude salt a cast.
